episodes.synopsis: The 3 Guyver units are stolen from the enigmatic Chronos Corporation in Japan. Guyver 1 is accidentally discovered by a young student, Sho Fukamachi, who triggers the units control mechanism. Transformed into the Guyver, he battles against the bio-morphic Zoanoids controlled by Chronos.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Determined to recover the stolen Guyvers, Chronos' headquarters dispatch an agent to confront Sho. But as the young student is about to be abducted, the agent is involuntarily transformed into Guyver II: a fighting unit, specially trained for combat. Sho's only hope is to summon the Guyver, thus thrusting the two mechas into deadly battle for survival.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Commander Gyou arrives from Chronos' headquarters to lead the recovery of the Guyver units. Meanwhile, Chronos Japan creates the Hyper Zoanoid "Zerebus" in a desperate attempt to eliminate the Guyver. To bait the trap, sho's girlfriend is kidnapped and Sho must once again become the Guyver and face challenge of Zerubus and the mysterious shadow, Guyver III.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Finally, Sho is convinced by his friend Tetsuro to publicly expose the existence of the evil Chronos organization. But before they have a chance, Commander Gyou attacks with Chronos' five most powerful Hyper Zoanoids. Escaping only to face a further sudden attack from the deadly cyborg warriors, it is clear that Guyver 1 will not survive the battle alone.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: The desperate Commander Gyou commands his men to transform Makishama, the head of Chronos Japan, into a Zoanoid armed with an enzyme capable of disintegrating the Guyver armor. To force a confrontation with Sho, Gyou has both his girlfriend and her brother kidnapped. They are taken to the mountains and forced to watch as Sho and the transmutated Makishama fight in a battle to the death!
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Mizuki and Tetsuro are imprisoned under heavy guard at Chronos' headquarters. With Sho believed dead, Tetsuro fears the worst as he begins to comprehend the enormous power of Chronos. Meanwhile, Guyver III's identity is finally revealed as he initiates his plan to destroy Chronos and Commander Gyou. But can Guyver 1 regenerate his control metal in time to save his girlfriend and her brother?
episodes.title: Episodio 6

Now Hikaru must compete for one of the two remaining seats. Hikaru decides not to visit Akira's Go Salon until he takes his place on the team with Akira. episodes.synopsis: Sasaki, a lonely office worker pushing forty, adopts an adorable bird to brighten up his life a bit... Little does he know that the Java sparrow he picks, Peeps, is a powerful mage who's going to bring him a whole lot more than he bargained for.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Sasaki gets the hang of his trading operation in the other world right about the time he gets in over his head in the modern world. He's (forcibly) recruited into a government agency for psychics, and his first job is right around the corner.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Sasaki catches wind of an unsettling development in the other world that could spell trouble for the entire country, let alone his trading operation. When called upon to help, can he use his modern business skills to make a difference?
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Lady Elsa is told to come out of hiding, marry, and lead the Müller House, but surprises abound as a Sage is discovered.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Sasaki returns to the modern world to find out there's been an interesting development while he was away, and little does he know yet another strange turn awaits him on his next job.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: After a... magical encounter, Sasaki finds himself in an unlikely alliance with the most dangerous psychic around. Can he convince his other allies that she's not the threat she appears to be? And can he find a way to profit from this?
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: The war may be over for now, but the conflict has left the king shaken... and he's about to announce a new policy that will shake up the rest of the kingdom too.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Sasaki's unexpected stowaway casts his dealings with Futari Shizuka into doubt. Is there any way he can salvage the deal and keep Elsa happy so as not to ruin his relationship with her father, the count? A little sightseeing is in order!
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Marc has been thrown into prison for a farce of an offense, and it's up to Sasaki to cook up an otherwordly scheme to get him out... and maybe make a tidy profit in the process.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: The hour of Marc's execution draws near, and Sasaki is ready to lay everything on the table in one final gambit to save his life.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: After an urgent call from Futari Shizuka, Sasaki and Peeps rush to save her from her old organization in a battle that goes, er, straight to the top?
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: After finishing the battle with the hostile organization, Sasaki receives a report from Hoshizaki that Magical Pink and Magical Yellow have appeared at the office. Then he was surrounded by a foreboding atmosphere.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: Un giorno, un impiegato compra un simpatico uccellino al negozio di animali scoprendo in seguito che si tratta in realtà di un illustre saggio che si è reincarnato da un altro mondo. Al giovane viene conferito un immenso potere magico, insieme alla possibilità di attraversare mondi. Così, decide di usare queste abilità per vivere una vita comoda; ma presto scoprirà che il Giappone è abitato da esseri dotati di abilità speciali.
info.title: Sasaki and Peeps

info.synopsis: Mahito, dopo la morte della madre a causa dei bombardamenti su Tokyo, si trasferisce in campagna insieme al padre, il quale si è appena risposato con la sorella della defunta moglie. Mentre Mahito lotta per accettare questa situazione incontra un airone parlante che, con la promessa di fargli reincontrare la madre, lo fa entrare in un altro mondo.
info.title: Il ragazzo e l'airone

episodes.synopsis: 灵医桃夭的云游之旅再次启程，谁料出师不利，竟迷了路，幸而偶遇贺山小兄弟热心投喂，觅食途中又遇见身染怪病的马家娘子，看来还得去乌头镇上一探究竟。 他们傍晚来到了古井旁，在喝过云姨的粥后，柳公子、磨牙和滚滚都变得有些奇怪......
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: 如果当一只应声虫，就能留住想要的东西，那活着，也未免太容易了。 云姨欲问姻缘，云姨有何放不下的执念呢？ 金铃声响，揭开过往情仇。 我以为他会回头再看我一眼， 这厢是十里红妆娶娇娘，那厢是三尺白绫自断殤。 柳公子托地府朋友打听后方知，故事的结局竟是这般......
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: 众人驱车前往鹿门寺，在这里觉悔和尚请求故交桃夭治病; 「活神仙」空明真人隐瞒多年的秘密也即将被揭开......
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: 杂耍艺人张二狗受人白眼、备受欺凌，一条小白蛇的出现让他在濒临绝望时重新振作; 一次偶然的机会拯救了一个大旱数月的村庄，从此张二狗改姓更名，道号空明......
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: 在百姓的崇拜中迷失自我，空明真人无止尽地向小白索要蛇丹，最终导致小白元神受损而失控; 死而复生的小白再次出现，那被杀掉的蛇妖又是谁呢？
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: 为保护心爱之人，觉悔走了极端，但对方临死前的一句话，却成了他的心魔，觉悔为参悟强者的真谛，愿自断蛇尾在鹿门寺礼佛。 千年前的觉悔是被视为不祥之物的化蛇，而如今他法号里不变的「悔」字又源自何故？
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: 神秘人掳走磨牙，竟是要他去成亲。 为救磨牙，桃夭和柳公子来到天水镇，在镇上闲逛时，桃夭察觉出空气里弥漫的是带雄黄的香料，进入饭馆天仙楼，撞破了天仙楼老板的秘密勾当，老板夫妇受威胁买卖重病之人，却认为这是你情我愿、皆大欢喜之事......
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: 得知磨牙去向后，桃夭与柳公子装病混入温府，面对满车奄奄一息又心如死灰的病者，桃夭不禁陷入沉思。 桃夭和柳公子混入温府之中，准备伺机将其救出，桃夭识破温夫人身份「媼」，食亡者，能断人死时，得人形者皆为貌美之女，称媼姬。 媼姬宁愿付出生命的代价，也不愿说出磨牙的位置，而另一边，磨牙则遇到了温家小姐山海......
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: 磨牙与山海进入到幻境之中，面对似曾相识的场景，山海突然唤起昔日恋人的名字若麟。 若麟赠予山海定情信物相约私奔，温夫人究竟对山海说了什么，使其最终放弃了赴约呢？ 山海得知若麟只剩半年寿命后，仍选择继续和他在一起，但是与母亲同为媼姬的山海注定无法与若麟长相厮守......
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: 磨牙说桃夭是个刀子嘴豆腐心的人，表面上谁都不在乎，但其实是个很怕寂寞的人，即便两人日常打闹拌嘴，但磨牙依然坚信桃夭会来救自己。 山海求生的欲望越是低迷，怪物的力量就越强大。 磨牙一次又一次地呼唤山海的名字，试图将其从迷境中唤醒，山海最终无法逃脱被怪物吞噬的命运，得知女儿已死的温夫人因急火攻心而陷入了昏迷，山海的性命是否还有挽回的余地？
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: 惊蛰从众人手中救下伤痕累累的媼姬，身为术士的他究竟是善是恶？ 他与媼姬之间又发生了什么事呢？ 不可思议！ 原本应针锋相对的媼姬与术士居然当上了邻居，甚至结为了夫妇？ 惊蛰虽到死都深爱着媼姬，却以人妖殊途的理由劝媼姬离开自己。 这个男人是我的救命恩人，是我此生挚爱的夫君，却也是亲手将我推进地狱的人。
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: 媼姬口中绝情的丈夫惊蛰，其实从未离开妻女的身边。 秦管家真身乃照海，面部为一块明镜的妖怪，照海跟随了惊蛰22年，目睹了媼姬与惊蛰之间发生的一切，照海化身秦姓男子，救下遭遇劫匪的媼姬与山海，终于等到了留在她们身边的机会。 照海最终选择用自己一生仅一次的能力，换取山海的重生，时光倒流，重归于初，山海这一次，要做一个幸福的姑娘，管它是妖怪还是人类。
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: Following a devastating attack, Lu Guang returns to the time when he first met Cheng Xiaoshi, determined to prevent the future he witnessed. As he relives the beginning of their friendship, a series of seemingly ordinary encounters begins setting their shared destiny in motion once again.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: While Liu Xiao becomes trapped in a dangerous wager at a Bridon bar, Cheng Xiaoshi discovers a photograph apparently sent by his missing father. Believing it may provide a clue about his parents, he decides to travel to Bridon, despite Qiao Ling’s strong objections.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Following clues connected to Cheng Xiaoshi’s missing parents, he and Lu Guang arrive in Bridon and visit a bar popular with football supporters. There they meet the friendly Xia Fei, but an impulsive celebration provokes a rival group and draws the three into a dangerous chase through the city.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: After Xia Fei’s enigmatic boss, Vein, rescues the group from their pursuers, Lu Guang becomes suspicious of their new ally. Cheng Xiaoshi later returns to the bar seeking information about BAHATI, where he uncovers a connection to a language school destroyed in a devastating fire ten years earlier.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: After witnessing the academy fire, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang search for anyone who survived the disaster. Their investigation leads Cheng into a photograph belonging to Wang Qing, a gifted student trapped in a difficult situation, where he uncovers a personal connection that may bring him closer to the truth about his father.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: To earn Vein’s help in locating Wang Qing, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang agree to replace a missing model at a photo shoot. Their unusual payment leads them to Wang Qing’s mental health clinic, where her psychological tests begin raising unsettling questions about the people and hidden motives surrounding their investigation.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

info.synopsis: Per salvare il defunto Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang torna all'inizio, ripercorrendo il cammino del destino. Tuttavia, una foto contenente indizi sui genitori di Cheng Xiaoshi appare nello “Studio fotografico del tempo”. Per scoprire la verità, Lu Guang si reca nervosamente a Bridon con Cheng Xiaoshi. L'amichevole top model Xia Fei, l'eccentrico leader di Chinatown, Vein, e il misterioso Liu Xiao... Di fronte a persone con motivazioni diverse, riuscirà Lu Guang a sbloccare la situazione?

episodes.synopsis:
俺はボロアパートに住む、冴えないフリーター・壮介。可愛くて巨乳の大家さん・由紀だけが心の癒し。

でも２階の住人が床を毎日ドンドンしてきて…許せん！怒りに行ったら出てきたのは、これまた可愛い女の子・砂生。

つい許しちゃった俺は、ついでに砂生でエロい妄想してたら…なんと天井が底抜けて、２階のあの子が落ちてきた！！

しかもそのまま「俺」の真上へ…こんなのもう、ガマンできるわけねぇーっ！！
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis:
砂生と密着してたのを由紀さんに見られて…完全に詰んだ俺。と思っていたら、大家として穴が空いた責任を取ると言い出し…！？

なぜか由紀さんと同じ部屋で暮らすことに！

だけど由紀さんの寝姿、胸とか尻とか無防備すぎる…っ！

しかも寝相が悪すぎて、向こうからガンガン密着してくる始末！ここまでされたらもうたまんねぇーっ！

ちょっとくらいちょっかい出しても…俺、悪くないよねっ！？
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: 由紀さんにイタズラしちゃって…部屋に境界線を引かれてしまった…。あの癒しが無くなるなんて嫌だ…と思いつつ、気まずい夜がまたやってくる…。もうエロいことは自粛しよう…と誓う俺だが、なんと天井の穴から砂生が降りてきたっ！しかもエロい格好で誘ってきて…！？隣に由紀さんいるのに…！バレたら終わりなのに…！でも、おねだり断るなんて男じゃない！しゃぁねぇ…！やってやるぜーっ！
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis:
砂生が忘れてったパンツを由紀さんが見つけちゃって…問い詰められる俺。

今度こそ終わりか…と思ったら、玄関から突然砂生の声が！

それに驚き転んだ拍子に、由紀さんの前ボタンが弾けて…ぽろりっ！？

しかも砂生はパンツ探しに部屋へ入ろうとして…この状況、ヤバすぎる！

とっさに由紀さんと押し入れに隠れた俺。だけど暗くて狭くて密着してたら…外に砂生がいるのに…またエロいことしたくなってきた…。
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis:
エロいことしすぎちゃった俺を監視するため、なぜか砂生まで一緒に寝ることに…。

美女2人に挟まれて、寝れるわけねぇっ…！しかもお風呂に入ろうとしたら、そこにも砂生が！？

ごめん…っ！と退散しようとするも、一緒に入ろ？と誘われて…。

そこまで言われて逃げられるか…っ！

泡でぬるぬる！シャワーで責め責め！

あんなとこやこんなとこまで、徹底的に洗いっこしてやるっ！
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis:
３人で温泉旅行に行くことになった俺達。

露天風呂から聞こえてきた女子トークは…「３人で楽しいことしたい」っ！？３人でって…それってまさか…？今夜は絶対寝れねぇ…っ！

なのに、夕飯食べたら砂生は早々に寝てて…由紀さんも酔っ払ってる…。だめだこりゃ…と思ってたら、浴衣のはだけた由紀さんが絡んできて…！？

赤らんで汗ばむカラダがエロすぎる…っ！砂生を待たずして…始めちゃうってこと！？
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis:
由紀さんと一緒に、砂生が主演の舞台を観に行くことに。

いきなり結構な濡れ場を演じる砂生に、目が釘付けになる俺。

隣を見ると、由紀さんも頬を赤らめてて…可愛い。

我慢できずに手を出しちゃう俺だが、由紀さんもなぜか受け入れてくれて…まさか砂生に嫉妬してる…？

バレないように声を抑え、砂生の演技と盛り上がりが重なるように…由紀さんと俺も高まっていき…。
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis:
俺の幼なじみ・柚子の登場で、ますますカオスになっていく俺の生活…！

しかも俺を取り合うために、４人で海水浴に行くことに！？美女3人の水着姿なんて…我慢できるわけねぇ…。

さっそく柚子とは一緒の浮輪に入ることになってしまい…ぎゅうぎゅうに密着して、たまらん…っ！

それに嫉妬した砂生には、小屋に連れ込まれ…迫られてっ！？

エロすぎて最高なんだけど…もう俺のカラダもたねぇよーっ！
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis:
他の２人とエロいことしたのバレちゃって…由紀さんにシャワー室へ連れ込まれた俺。

いつになく積極的に迫る由紀さんにタジタジ…っ！だけど他の個室に砂生と柚子も入ってきて…！？

壁越しの女子トークの中、砂生に俺への気持ちを聞かれた由紀さんはつい「あ…あんな人、大っ嫌い！」と答えて…。

もう怒った！今度は俺から迫ってやるっ！皆にバレないよう耐える由紀さんを、激しく攻めて責めまくる！
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: For five hundred million years, the Angels have been watching Earth from Planet Eden. They have documented the virtues and vices of the Earthians. If the wrongs exceed the rights, Earth will then be destroyed. Kagetsuya and Chihaya are sent to the Earth to investigate the positive and negative sides of the Earthians.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Chihaya is haunted by strange visions of black wings. Do they hold a special secret, or is it a disease that is prepared to claim his angelic life? Chihaya's search leads him to Sapphire, a black winged, fallen angel. Un- fortunately, Sapphire has become a rock star who lives in hiding and is tormented by a lethal drug habit.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: The Great War between the Angels and the Earthians is over, but Dr. Ashino still lives. While Chihaya and Kagetsuya, are in the midst of rescuing two young angels from the doctor's horrific laboratory, they stumble upon Messiah. Messiah, a genetically engineered destroyer in the form of a beautiful young angel, only has eyes for sweet Chihaya.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Messiah is missing, and presumed dead. Chihaya, however, is convinced the angelic destroyer is very much alive, and his obsession with finding Messiah is endangering his relationship with Kagetsuya. Now Chihaya will not only lose Messiah to the mad Dr. Ashino, but he may lose his own life to the very one whom he cares most about.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

info.synopsis: Gli angeli del pianeta Eden hanno osservato gli abitanti della Terra, per 5 miliardi di anni. Chihaya, un angelo dalle ali nere, è incaricato di rilevare le caratteristiche positive dell'umanità mentre il biondo Kagetsuya, che viaggia con lui, deve trovare quelle negative. I due tengono traccia delle azioni delle persone e danno dei punteggi in base alla bontà o meno di esse, calcolando con numeri positivi gli atti di altruismo e negativi quelli di malvagità; se mai il punteggio dovesse scendere al di sotto dei 10000 punti la Terra sarà distrutta La storia segue Chihaya e Kagetsuya ed in particolare le diverse persone ed eventi che osservano lungo il loro viaggio.
info.title: Earthian

episodes.synopsis: While Lupin does enjoy racing for the sport of it, the prize in an antique car grand prix across Europe is Lupin's only goal. The prize is a dictionary that once belonged to Napoleon. More importantly, the dictionary was also once owned by Lupin's family and contains the location of one of his family's most prized possessions. Lupin does not know what the possession is, but it is a matter of family pride. With the usual suspects on his trail, can Lupin outrace everyone to the treasure?

info.synopsis:
Con la tremenda battaglia tra Pharis, somma divinità della luce, e Pharalis, suprema dea delle tenebre, l'era degli dèi giunse al termine. Dopo innumerevoli combattimenti le ultime due dee rimaste, Marpha, madre della creazione, e Kardis, malefica dea della distruzione, si distrussero a vicenda generando una piccola isola maledetta dal sangue di Kardis: Lodoss. Molti anni sono passati dalla grande guerra degli dèi e gli umani hanno colonizzato Lodoss, dando inizio a una serie praticamente infinita di guerre. Questa volta il pericolo giunge da Marmo, piccola isola a sud-est di Lodoss in cui giace il corpo di Kardi
Questo l'incipit della saga, che vede il giovane umano Parn lasciare il suo piccolo villaggio natale per capire cosa stia succedendo sull'isola e per spiegare l'improvvisa proliferazione di goblin nei dintorni del villaggio. Nel suo viaggio si uniranno a lui l'elfa Deedlit, il ladro Woodchuck, il mago Slayn, il nano guerriero Gym e l'amico d'infanzia Eto, chierico di Pharis.

episodes.synopsis: In the prologue (set during the Battle of A Baoa Qu in December U.C.0079), Zeon ace pilot Anavel Gato returns from combat to find Admiral Aiguille Delaz telling him of the deaths of Gihren Zabi and Kycilia Zabi, as the Zeon forces surrender. Despite the shock defeat, both men retreat and plan the return of Zeon. In October U.C.0083, the Federation space carrier Albion delivers two Gundam Development Project (GDP) prototypes, the RX-78 GP01 Zephyranthes and the GP02A Physalis, to the Torrington Base in Australia for ground testing under the aegis of Anaheim Electronics engineer Nina Purpleton. Because of lax security, a Zeon mole helps Gato infiltrate the base and hijack the GP02 just after its nuclear weapon is loaded in the middle of the night. Having witnessed Gato activate the mobile suit, Ensign Kou Uraki takes over the Zephyranthes and prepares to face him just as Zeon forces assault the base.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Kou, his friend Chuck Keith, and veterans South Burning and Dick Allen follow Gato through the outback in an attempt to recapture the Physalis. Zeon forces ambush them and kill Allen as Gato awaits a Komusai shuttle for extraction. Kou destroys the shuttle but it is actually a diversion - Gato escapes on a submarine that provided covering fire during the Torrington base attack.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Back at Torrington, Federation General John Kowen assigns Burning to lead the Albion's pursuit of Gato with a new crew of pilots to help him. Kou and Keith join the mission. Lt. Bernard Monsha, one of the new additions, doubts Kou's capability to fly the GP01. Despite Nina's assurance that Kou handled the mobile suit well, Monsha challenges him to a first-shot mobile suit duel to see who better deserves to pilot the Zephyranthes. Although Kou wins the match, Burning intervenes and sends both pilots to one week in the brig. Meanwhile, Gato heads for the Kinbareid diamond mine in East Africa, which is still occupied by Zeon holdouts from the One Year War.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Somewhere in East Africa, the Albion goes on patrol, while Monsha faces Albion chief engineer Mora Bascht's wrath for hitting on the ship's female crew and trying to sabotage Kou's landing after his search patrol. Gato arrives at Kinbareid and boosts the morale of the soldiers. Meanwhile, Orville - the Zeon mole who helped Gato's infiltration in the first episode - has been unmasked and flies out in a Core Fighter II to warn Kinbareid of the Albion's patrols but could not find the base complex and is shot down by a Zaku patrol. The Zeon forces mobilize and attack the Albion to buy time for Gato and the GP02 to fly into orbit using one Heavy Launch Vehicle still in the base. The base holdouts surrender as soon as Gato flies away.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Gato flies back to the Garden of Thorns, a secret Zeon colony base in the Shoal Zone, to present the GP02 to Delaz. However, a chance encounter with Zeon commander Cima Garahau rankles him when their ships almost collide. Upon delivering the GP02, Delaz makes an Earth Sphere-wide declaration of war, explaining that the GP02 and its nuclear weapon is proof of the Earth Federation's military buildup. Meanwhile, aboard the Albion, Nina tries to get closer to a dense Kou when the alert sounds. Kou and the rest of the Albion's mobile suit pilots engage the Zeon intruders. However, Nina's warning about the GP-01's poor mobility in space without the so-called Full Vernian (Full Burnern) backpack proves true as Kou crashlands in the Albion under heavy damage.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: The Albion arrives at Von Braun City on the Moon to have the GP01 upgraded to Full Vernian (Full Burnern) while the crew goes on shore leave. A snide comment from Monsha at a bar prompts Kou to wander around the city where he is beaten up by some thugs. A one-armed man named Kelley Layzner rescues him and brings him to a junkyard where he lives with his lover. Kou learns of Kelley's origins as a Zeon pilot and helps him fix a Val Walo mobile armor that has been hidden for years. He returns to the Albion and begins testing the Full Vernian-equipped GP01. Elsewhere in the city, Cima blackmails Anaheim boss Gilbert O'Sullivan with a colony drop if he talks to the Federation about her. She also tells Kelley to get the Val Walo ready for action.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Cima's blackmailing apparently works, as Anaheim asks Nina to be reassigned away from the Albion and out of the mobile suit development team altogether. Keith, who dates Mora, offers Kou movie tickets so he can ask Nina out after a field test. He does make a move, but a remark about the tests angers Nina again. Meanwhile, Kelley gets paid in gold bullion for his work on the Val Walo, but is shocked to hear that the Zeon forces do not want him piloting it for the new campaign. Incensed, Kelley takes out the mobile armor and challenges Kou to fight him so he could prove himself worthy of joining the Delaz Fleet again. When Nina gets in the way, Kou finally admits his feelings for her and defeats Kelley, who does not bail out from the exploding Val Walo because he never installed an escape system.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: A few days out of Von Braun, Burning continues to train Kou and Keith, who later eggs him to try giving Nina a chance. Keith also earns Mora's ire for showing him Monsha's private collection of Nina pictures. A resupply rendezvous by a Federation ship is cut short as the Albion detects the Federation flagship Birmingham, with General Green Wyatt aboard - meeting with Cima. In the midst of the ensuing battle, Burning retrieves a briefcase that contains files for something called "Operation Stardust" and talks with Kou about them. However, a minor hit on Burning's GM Custom during the battle turns fatal, as the mobile suit careens out of control and explodes. Uraki is promoted to junior lieutenant as the crew mourns Burning's death.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Kou and Keith continue to fight Zeon forces while on patrol near Konpeitoh (Solomon). As Delaz welcomes the Axis Advance Fleet into the Earth Sphere, Gato prepares for his own part of an attack on Konpeitoh, which is hosting the Naval Review. The Delaz Fleet keeps probing the Federation defenses, keeping Kou occupied. A defense satellite detects Gato breaking through another sector and Uraki is ordered to intercept him before he crashes the Review. He fails to get to Gato in time, as the Zeon pilot fires the GP02's MK82 nuclear bazooka at the Federation fleet with the Birmingham in the center of his sights.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Gato retreats after the nuclear strike destroys two-thirds of the Federation's fleet, but runs into Kou. As Nina breaks down watching them fight, both of their mobile suits take heavy damage and the pilots flee before they explode. Meanwhile, Cima's fleet hijacks two colonies in transport and later blow off one mirror each from them. When the Albion crew is informed of the colonyjack, Nina correctly theorizes that the colonies will crash into each other, with one in direct course for the Moon. She also reveals the existence of a third Gundam built under the GDP.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: The Albion arrives at Anaheim Electronics' La Vie En Rose research ship to get the GP03 Dendrobium Stamen, where they are met by designer Lucette Auduvie and Federation officer Nakaha Nakato. Almost immediately, Nakato tells the crew that the GDP has been suspended and they are all confined to the Albion until further notice. Lucette shows Kou the GP03's diagrams and later sacrifices her life to stop Nakato killing Kou as he takes over the GP03 with the Albion crew's help and leave La Vie En Rose. Meanwhile, the Federation command expresses indifference at the upcoming Zeon colony drop on the Moon. The Konpeitoh survivors mobilize and try to stop it, but run out of fuel when Cima maneuvers to have Von Braun City's laser station activate the colony's engines to redirect it toward Earth. Gato also meets up with the Axis Advance Fleet, where he gets the massive Neue Ziel mobile armor and tries it against a small Federation patrol.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Kou and Gato, now in their mobile armors, finally take each other on as the Albion crew tries to stop the colony before it passes the minimum limit for terminal entry. Cima's crew takes Delaz hostage aboard his flagship, the Gwaden. At Jaburo, General Kowen desperately tries to convince EFSF supreme commander Gen Gene Collini of mobilizing the military's full might to stop the colony, but Jamitov Hymen has Kowen taken away. Delaz discovers that the Federation has deployed the Solar System II mirror array past the terminal entry point and encourages Gato to see the operation through - before Cima kills him. Out of rage, Gato drives one of the Neue Ziel's claws at the Gwaden bridge.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: The battle to stop the colony goes full-blast, with the Federation and Cima's forces working together to protect the Solar System II on one hand and the Delaz fleet shepherding the colony on the other while the Axis Advance Fleet stands back. Kou kills Cima in the fracas. The Solar System II fires, but Gato destroys the command ship, resulting in a weaker blast that barely damages the colony. As it breaks through the solar array, Gato enters the colony and inputs the final course corrections. Kou tries to stop him, but Nina interferes and protects Gato as they leave, revealing that they were once lovers. The two pilots continue to fight after Gato has Karius bring Nina to safety. The Solar System II remnants fire again, with many forces on both sides destroyed as the colony crashes into the Midwest. The Federation orders the Axis Advance Fleet to leave the Earth Sphere immediately, having overstayed their welcome, but Gato leads the Delaz Fleet survivors to attempt a breakthrough and dies in a kamikaze attack on a Federation ship. Several weeks later, Hymen and Bask Om announce the creation of the Titans. All records of Operation Stardust and the GP are erased, including Kou's one-year hard labor sentence. He eventually reunites with Nina, Keith, and Mora.
episodes.title: Episodio 13

episodes.synopsis: CITY - dove ogni giorno succede qualcosa: Tsurubishi infila dei noodle fritti nella borsa di un cliente, sotto gli occhi di Nagumo! Una situazione disperata! Matsuri ed Eri si divertono dopo la scuola. Todoroki e Onikamaboko non trovano uno scherzo per "Rakutan-kun." Dopo aver sentito il sogno di Niikura, Nagumo inizia a pensare a quello che vogliono fare... Qualcosa inizia a sbocciare in CITY.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Nagumo, sempre al verde, si scontra con Niikura, che rivuole semplicemente I suoi soldi. L'arrivo di Wako accende la caotica vita del campus. Nel frattempo, la squadra di calcio di CITY Minami Eleven Soccer si affanna per proteggere il suo asso sempre infortunato, Sasago. Todoroki negozia il destino di Rakutan-kun, mettendo alla prova il legame tra editore e autore. E il sole tramonta su City.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Con uno spettacolo imminente, Tekaridake, leader del Teatro Tekaridake, riunisce la sua troupe demotivata. La sonnambula Riko Izumi ruba il cuore del 16enne Tatewaku Makabe. La primavera è dietro l'angolo. Matsuri ed Eri cercano di proteggere la pace mondiale con la gentilezza. Nagumo, Niikura e Wako trovano una mappa del tesoro... che la battaglia inizi! Un altro giorno pacifico a CITY.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Tanabe ama dare premi per qualsiasi attività, e ora inizia la ricerca di Nagumo! Tsurubishi visita l'izakaya 'Yamabushi', che vuole arrivare a poter dire l'iconico 'Capo! Il solito!' e inizia a frequentarlo. Niikura insegue una collana rimasta attaccata a una 'Mimineko. Matsuri si avventurano nella ricerca della Mimineko. Le vite di ogni persona si intersecano in City.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Nagumo viene portato via da Tanabe. Sono destinato alle Tanabe Residence Hospitality Twin Towers. Con l'aiuto di una persona gentile incontrata lungo la strada, Nagumo e Wako cercano di scappare, ma i guardiani di ogni piano tagliano loro la strada... Intanto, Niikura continua a correre temerariamente inseguendo la Mimineko. I punti scollegato iniziano a connettersi in CITY.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: La mattina a casa Adatara è sempre frenetica. Umi, Sora, Kamome, Tatsuta e Rota partono insieme come sempre. Il manoscritto anonimo 'Kanki-kun' arriva all'ufficio editoriale della rivista City. Vedendo qualcosa di speciale in esso, Todoroki fa una proposta a Onikamaboko. In riva al fiume al tramonto, Eri cerca di comunicare qualcosa a Matsuri... Le stagioni di CITY continuano a cambiare.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Sostituendo il proprietario del Bar Yamabushi, Tsurubishi decide di fare il riso fritto definitivo. Ne va del suo orgoglio, quindi cerca gli ingredienti perfetti. A tarda notte, Niikura è affamata e mangia qualunque cosa trovi. Intanto, Kuratake, il barbiere noto come "uomo più cattivo in città", ha venduto i regali dei suoi clienti fissi... per uno scopo. In CITY, non c'è luce senza oscurità.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Una ragazza innamorata non riesce a smettere di piangere. Dopo 18 anni in attesa di un invito, Tanabe scopre finalmente il cibo preferito della sua bella? Tekaridake scrittura Nagumo come protagonista di "Gola". Nonostante innumerevoli fallimenti, riesce ad alzare il sipario! Un agente di polizia diventa un fan di Riko Izumi. Anche Tatewaku le chiede di uscire. Qualcosa sta sbocciando in CITY.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: A CITY c'è una corsa con un premio di un milione di yen. Nagumo affronta Obaba. Niikura vuole rubare il ciondolo ai CITY Minami Eleven. Tekaridake corre con una coppia al traino. Matsuri ed Eri sono sincronizzati. I Tre Corvi tengono in mano del buon saké. Con sorprese a ogni turno, l'imprevedibile corsa tiene tutti in tensione... A chi sorriderà la dea? Mentre tutti corrono, CITY inizia a girare!
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Nagumo e Niikura hanno un piano per diventare ricchi tramite i video in streaming. Tutta via, la reazione di Nagumo al sincero copione di Niikura è... Intanto, il fan club di Riko Izumi ostacola Tatewaku. Il capitano dei CITY Minami Eleven, Obina, guida la carica per fermare la furia di Tatewaku! Intanto, i Tre Corvi partono per una breve vacanza. L'estate di CITY è frenetica!
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Mentre Niikura registra un video, arriva Nagumo... Toki, Tsuchinoko e Mimineko... Ci sono tutte le creature di CITY. Nella "Coppa Shogi a sorpresa" si sfidano Arashima, 8° Dan e Hidari, 4° Dan. Chi crollerà per primo? Todo, proprietario di Todo Antichità, vede lo spirito degli oggetti antichi. Guardando ciò che resta degli abitanti di CITY tra gli oggetti di Kuratake... l'estate di CITY continua.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Nagumo, Niikura e Wako si iscrivono a un concorso fotografico, con i loro migliori scatti, e attendono il risultato! Eri visita dei luoghi pieni di ricordi di Matsuri. I Tre Corvi bevono a volontà al ristorante occidentale Makabe durante le vacanze di primavera. L'infinito ritornello di "delizioso" continua. L'estate di CITY è tutt'altro che finita.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: Eri lascia Matsuri senza dire una parola. Per dirle addio come si deve, Matsuri si fionda da Eri! Tsurubishi e il ristorante occidentale Makabe... una svolta inattesa? Tra risate, lacrime, e tutto quello che accade nel frattempo, l'ultimo episodio è pieno di sorprese! Mentre l'estate a CITY finisce, ne inizia un'altra.
episodes.title: Episodio 13

info.synopsis: Midori è un po' in difficoltà. info.synopsis: Takeru Hidaka è un tranquillo studente liceale che si è appena fidanzato con la dolce Kaori Koga. Tuttavia, l'attenzione del ragazzo è sempre stata catturata da Tomoko Yoshioka, la migliore amica della fidanzata, dotata di un fascino provocante e formoso. L'equilibrio si spezza definitivamente durante un pomeriggio al karaoke: Tomoko si imbuca e, rimasta sola con Takeru, lo seduce apertamente. Nonostante i forti sensi di colpa, il ragazzo cede alla travolgente attrazione fisica, intraprendendo con lei una relazione clandestina. Takeru si ritrova così intrappolato in un pericoloso triangolo amoroso, diviso tra l'affetto per la fidanzata ufficiale e la totale dipendenza dai giochi proibiti della sua migliore amica, in un vortice di tradimenti.
